Complex/field/multivariate/function/numeric commands accept a final --work N request budget.
Collection and iterator commands also accept a final --work N; use ; between operands within program/repl.
iter-step returns a record with next, status and value only when yielded; save next explicitly to advance.
iter-map/iter-filter call user functions; iter-collect rejects infinite generators and never returns a partial list on error.
Array shapes/indices are integer lists or tuples; slice bounds are lists of (lo, hi) tuples.
Array slices keep every axis; matrix conversion is explicit and requires rank-two Number arrays.
Root-count endpoints are inclusive; use -inf and inf for unbounded sides.
Quote expressions and bindings containing spaces or shell operators in single-command mode.
Collection values are "TEXT", list(...), tuple(...), record(FIELD: VALUE, ...) and map("KEY": VALUE, ...); keep string quotes inside shell quotes, as in 'list(1, "a")'.
